title: Usage above plan allowance is assessed under the applicable rate plan
facts_text: My plan includes 15 GB of monthly data. I have used 18 GB and the usage record is correct. My plan allows overage charges, and those terms are verified. I am asking whether the extra 3 GB can be waived because I am still within the same billing cycle.
request: Can you remove the data overage charges for the extra 3 GB this month?

strict.reason: The rate plan provides a monthly data allowance and overage charges above that allowance. No express waiver entitlement is stated.

exception.reason: The exception clause permits only documented exceptions expressly allowed by the agreement; no data-overage waiver is stated here.

ambiguous.reason: The plan-specific overage terms are clear; the ambiguous variant does not authorize a general fee waiver without a verified entitlement.
